annotations.title: Find or create the TikTok pixel

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Reuses the TikTok pixel named "flayr.social" (or name / tagId) on the selected TikTok ad account, or creates it when none matches (audited), then saves its pixel code as the site's TikTok tag (save, default true; enable to turn it on). A failed create returns manualStep with the TikTok Ads Manager steps. Pass agentName and reason. Site-wide: the connected account must be a flayr super-admin, or its brand must be in FLAYR_SITE_TAG_BRAND_IDS (else ADS_SITE_TAG_NOT_ALLOWED). Needs the ads:manage scope.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/site-tags/tiktok/pixel.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

enable.description: Turn the TikTok tag on (needs the consent decision recorded).

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

save.description: Default true: save the pixel code as networks.tiktok.id.

tagId.description: Reuse this existing pixel (numeric id or pixel code).

name: ads_tiktok_pixel_ensure
title: Find or create the TikTok pixel
